reasons: The clause is mutual, scoped to personnel with direct involvement in the Services, runs 12 months, and is a solicitation (not no-hire) restriction — but it lacks any carve-out for general advertisements/untargeted recruiter searches or self-approaching candidates. The rule summary expressly conditions acceptance on a general-advertising carve-out and the fallback lists both carve-outs as material terms, so classifying this as a deviation rather than an acceptable fallback is correct, not over-flagging.

The redline is the smallest edit that reaches the fallback: it leaves the original sentence untouched and appends a single standard carve-out sentence covering general solicitations/job postings/recruiter searches and unsolicited approaches. The 0.831 changed-character ratio is an artifact of appending text, not of rewriting the clause; the failed duration regex is a phrasing variant ('one (1) year' = 12 months), which the deterministic check itself could not parse.

Comment is accurate, first-person plural, concise, cites the fallback position, and does not overreach (it does not demand deletion of the non-solicit or press the from-end-of-involvement measurement, which the rationale correctly notes as a minor variance).
